name: nepali-calendar-toolkit
description: Beyond conversion: configurable weekends, holidays, and date ranges for months, quarters, fiscal years, or any custom period. TypeScript port of the C# NepaliCalendarToolkit.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-baseline-index.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.react.json && node scripts/copy-data.mjs && node scripts/copy-styles.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:browser && npm run test:react
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:browser && npm run test:react
scripts.test:react: node test/react-free.test.mjs && node test/react.test.mjs && node test/react-dom.test.mjs

author: Sushil Shrestha
